title: National Park Visits Fell To 323 Million After Shutdown
hook: National park visits fell to 323 million after shutdown.
closing: Park demand survived the disruption, showing public lands still pull enormous crowds.
question: Which park would you still visit?

segments.say: National parks reached 331.9 million visits, setting the record immediately before disruption.
Visits fell to 323 million during the shutdown year, breaking the record-setting momentum.
Blue Ridge Parkway still drew 16.5 million visits, showing shutdown pressure did not erase demand.
